payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute largest powers of two <= h and w, then clamp within aspect ratio [0.8,1.25], try two candidate rectangles, pick max area (tie break max height).
payload.rationale: Solution uses ad-hoc math with powers of two and aspect ratio bounds; no sorting, binary search, or DP. None of the candidate subtypes fit, so I selected the highest-score option but mark family mismatch.
